runtime.note: source commit is the intended baseline; installed binary provenance must be verified by its builder

limitations: one intersection, no independent generalization estimate
annotations derived from HDMap and incomplete
unmatched proposals are not proven negatives
geometry proposals, no automatic semantic classification
no training, ground-truth registration or reference geometry supplied to generation
detector developed using this scene; not independent held-out generalization
10cm original-point decimation; fixed tile halos can still cause proposal differences
crosswalk outline is observed paint extent, reference is mapped crossing footprint
